Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: Special Episode "1986 in Review," with GCN clips and coverage from the year 1. Gay and Lesbian Alliance Against Defamation protests outside the New York Post offices 2. Coverage of the National Gay and Lesbian Taskforce meeting, featuring interviews with Sara Throne, Virginia Apuzzo, Peter Fowler, Urvashi Vaid on the impact and continuing future of the gay service organization COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 3. Mayor Koch attacked at the Proclamation of 1987 Gay Pride Week 4. Andy Humm on the 17th anniversary of the Stonewall Riots 5. Raymond Jacobs on the psychological impact of AIDS on communities 6. Gay Friends and Neighbors in Brooklyn 7. Coverage of the 17th Annual Gay and Lesbian Pride Day Parade in New York, 29 June 1986 COMMERCIAL: The Monster 8. Raymond Jacobs on dealing with AIDS related deaths in the young gay community 9. Clips from the July 4th 1986 NYC protest against the Supreme Court passage of the "Sodomy Laws" 10. Interview with Michael Hardwick, of the Bowers v. Hardwick Georgia "Sodomy Laws" case, and discussion of the case 11. Lyndon LaRouche placing the "AIDS quarantine" initiative on the California ballot COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" gay magazine COMMERCIAL: Dr. Ruth taping, call for gay guests to attend 12. "Stamp Out AIDS" project, interview with John Glines 13. Gay Christopher St Festival Committee sponsors a candlelight vigil for AIDS Resources Center Inc, which cares for homeless persons with AIDS 14. Gina Alvarez discusses the increase of activism of young gay students, especially on college campuses 15. Human Rights Campaign Fund Dinner, with speeches by Coretta Scott King and Harvey Fierstein 16. Closing credits, over clips of the Village Halloween Parade
